title: Dark Tide

{{Stub|References}} {{Terminology Infobox |title = The Dark Tide |type = Lore |image = The Dark Tide 4K.png |nation = Rinascita }} {{Quote|It is "Paradise."
"It is a place where sickness, hunger, sorrow, despair, and dullness of heart cease to exist. There, deacons sing eternal hymns..."|Cartethyia|[[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]]}} The '''Dark Tide''' is a form of [[Waveworn Phenomenon]] native to [[Rinascita]]. During the events of {{Quest|Veils Off in Sun or Shadow}}, in the depictions found in an abandoned [[Order of the Deep]] Tower, the first Dark Tide was brought about by historical wars between the early settlers of Rinascita, who were divided by their opposing faiths in the [[Threnodian]] [[Leviathan]] and the [[Sentinel]] [[Imperator]]. ==Archive Entry== {{Description|The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It manifests as a dark, swirling mass of clouds that gathers and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents like a waterfall. Whenever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new [[Tacet Field]].

There have been two significant Dark Tides in Ragunna's history. The first, according to the Order of the Deep, was stopped by [[Napoli II]], the first Primus of the Order. The second was quelled by the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden [[Cartethyia|Fleurdelys]].}} ==Synopsis== The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon used by the Threnodian [[Leviathan]] as part of its destructive nature due to [[The Lament|the Lament]]. According to the Primus [[Fenrico]], the true nature of the Dark Tide is that it is the "shed blood" of the Sentinel [[Imperator]] caused by the old wars of faith in Rinascita, thus weakening Their overall strength and preventing them from communicating directly to Their people.{{Quest|What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing}} :'''Fenrico:''' Do you know how the Dark Tide came into being? :'''Fenrico:''' In Rinascita, wars were waged in the name of faith, tearing apart the Sentinel as our faith divided, weakening Their divine power. :'''Fenrico:''' The Dark Tide's true essence is the divine blood shed from the Sentinel's wounds. In {{Quest|The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier}}, it is described by [[Cartethyia]] as a form of "'''Paradise'''," characterized by the cessation of suffering, hunger, sorrow, and emotional desolation.{{Quest|The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier}} :'''Cartethyia:''' It is "Paradise." :'''{{Rover}}:''' I take it you don't mean that in a good way? :'''Cartethyia:''' "It is a place where sickness, hunger, sorrow, despair, and dullness of heart cease to exist. There, deacons sing eternal hymns..." However, this idealized depiction masks its true nature: a mechanism of mass assimilation and indoctrination associated with the Leviathan.{{cite}} The Dark Tide initially spreads through direct contact, converting organic life into vessels that emit continuous hymns. These transformed entities—described as the dead who "grow mouths and sing hymns, day and night"—function as agents of psychological contagion, spreading madness and perceptual corruption. The process culminates in the aggregation of corrupted souls, which are drawn toward a central convergence known as the "Journeying Paradise."{{Quest|The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier}} :'''Cartethyia:''' From a literal standpoint, this line describes the Dark Tide perfectly. :'''Cartethyia:''' In the beginning, the Dark Tide would claim only the areas it touched, assimilating all life as its vanguard to clear the way for its spread. :'''Cartethyia:''' The dead... they would grow mouths and sing hymns, day and night. They didn't need eyes or ears, for their purpose was to spread blindness and madness. :'''Cartethyia:''' Even those who did not believe were drawn irresistibly to the Leviathan's creed. And for those already deceived, it was all but inevitable. :'''Cartethyia:''' When a soul is corrupted to its core, it will sing hymns without end on its sleepless journey to merge with the Dark Tide. :'''Cartethyia:''' And when every faithful soul has returned to "Paradise," the land consumed by the Dark Tide will begin its pilgrimage, drawn by darkened skies, spreading its "gospel" to wherever it lands next. :'''Cartethyia:''' The final act of the Dark Tide is.... the "Journeying Paradise." Once this threshold is reached, the affected region becomes mobile, guided by "darkened skies" and tasked with extending the reach of the Leviathan’s creed to new territories. Within the [[Sonoro Sphere]] of [[Avinoleum]], the residual destructive properties of the Dark Tide are significantly restrained. The region’s inverted gravity prevents the phenomenon from descending into Rinascita, thereby also halting the fall of Tacet Discords and the ruins of the [[Order of the Deep]] seminary. This gravitational inversion not only impedes further collapse but alters the Tide’s essence, rendering its waters unnaturally calm—navigable by gondola throughout the Sonoro Sphere. Despite this stabilization, remnants of the Dark Tide still manifest sporadically, often taking the form of rampant purple-hued vines and flowers that propagate across the Avinoleum landscape.{{Quest|The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier}} ==Effects and Properties== The Dark Tide's main purpose is indoctrinating those nearby into shifting their alignments with Leviathan's vision. Using the basis that is belief, the Dark Tide serves to corrupt other and reduce them as Hollow Figures that endlessly praise Leviathan and used as a vector to corrupt others nearby. Through Leviathan's acts of "twisted faith", during the time it impersonated [[Imperator]], [[Cantarella]] and [[Aalto]] explains that Rinascitans harbor a "spiritual Dark Tide" within them which has allowed the Dark Tide and Leviathan to take root into their collective subconsciousness with flows into into them. Through this the fears they feel are taken in which allows Leviathan to draw out the Dark Tide when enough anguish is gathered while using this connection to make unseen changes within the citizen's dreams itself. Using the Dark Tide to read the depths of others hearts to understand and use their anger, pain, and sorrow for itself. Once the Dark Tide is called into existence, those nearby will begin to experience hallucinations, illusions, or their deepest fears drawn forth and used against them while hearing whispers that may tempt them into joining. While there are methods to resist the Dark Tide's effects, be it through will power or the [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia Family]]'s potions, the ceaseless apparition's brought on a person will not vanish unless one is treated and leaves the vicinity where the Dark Tide is at. However, prolong exposure cannot be cured as Aulus, a Gladiator, found themselves transformed into a [[Tacet Discord]] and unable to be saved with those engulfed by the Dark Tide becoming either a Hollow Figure who sing hymns to draw others in or find themselves transformed into Tacet Discords themself. Even the Fisalia's antidotes, which can cure the lightly inflicted, is unable to save those with deep corruption and are unable to have their frequencies be reversed. Even Common Echoes break down from the corruption caused by the Dark Tide. Due to the Dark Tide holding an autonomy property, not necessarily requiring Leviathan to continue it's purposes, Anchor Obelisks, the Earthrend Wedge, and the Light of Genesis are required to hold the Dark Tide back from spreading itself across Rinascita while being sealed properly within the Avinoleum and [[Sanguis Plateaus]]. Even so, any area touched by the Dark Tide, especially in mass, is scarred such as [[the Wastelands]] itself. Its also possible for the Dark Tide to block any Priestess ability to see visions of Septimont's Auguries, leaving their sight of the future utterly blank. The Dark Tide may also possess and preserve the frequencies of others, memories. This entraps numerous lost souls within it which may be used as fuel Leviathan and its Journeying Paradise's rebirth. This allows the Dark Tide to be used as an entrance to the Journeying Paradise but also a method to utilize the lost and captured frequencies as a resource. In particular, the memories of Caligula were preserved and then forcibly merged with [[Avidius]] to allow Caligula a potential rebirth while the frequencies of numerous humans are gathered at Styx Lake, or Manes Deep as [[Chimera]] calls it, to be used as a furnace to melt down and reforge their souls to create a crude imitation of Remnant Creatures as Imperator themself did that must obediently follow Leviathan. The memories of [[Phrolova]] and [[Scar]] were also used against the [[Rover]] within their mindscape when they attempted to escape the Dark Tide itself. However, Phrolova's research found by Rover during [[Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens]] does claim that Tacet Discords generated by the Dark Tide consist of fragmented frequencies intensely fused together, causing the subjects to lack self-awareness. This means any collective consciousness formed through fusion is entirely shaped and controlled by Leviathan, thus the Dark Tide cannot sustain or preserve original human consciousness. Though, despite the Dark Tide being Leviathan's main weapon, even produce special Tacet Discords like Tyrannos as the vanguard, because of it's autonomous nature, it could potentially act out on its own purposes, as seen with [[the False Sovereign]] who could act out without Leviathan's guidance until the Threnodian regained full control over the Dark Tide later on. There is also one primary limitation of the Dark Tide itself. In spite of its effects on others, including Tacet Discords, it can only affect the Rinascitans due to their belief in the doctrines Leviathan has spread. For those outside the region, with the exception of the Rover, the Dark Tide holds no influence over their consciousness and rejects them. Though, were Leviathan to manifest the Journeying Paradise fully into the real world, then it may be possible for Leviathan to consume them as Cartethyia describes that the purpose of the Dark Tide, once it passes the threshold, the affected region becomes mobile, guided by "darkened skies" and tasked with extending the reach of the Leviathan’s creed to new territories. It's also possible for one to escape the Dark Tide’s grasp, such as Galbrena herself. Such actions, however, require external factors such as Chimera and the souls of others like Arkyria to allow her escape, and had been cursed with her Resonance Ability being corrupted and weakened for a time. Even so, this gave Galbrena a connection with the Dark Tide and allowed her to walk within it through her own mind, guiding those who were lost within back home. ===Journeying Paradise=== The creation, sanctuary, and kingdom of Leviathan. It is a realm that resides within the Dark Tide and is a world where it's true purpose is to engulf Rinascita so they may live within it. One of the main purposes of the Dark Tide is to flood the Rinascita with the Dark Tide so that the Journeying Paradise may manifest into the real world itself. Through the Dark Tide, where Rinacita's subconscious beliefs flow and is made manifest, Leviathan used the conflict [[Cristoforo]] caused across Ragunna and Septimont to cause fear which in turn shaped the citizens desires for a blissful afterlife after death, which constructed the Journeying Paradise from these prayers where upon full manifestation, combined with Leviathan's power of assimilation, everyone will be forcibly made to have no thoughts and simply pray towards Leviathan with no will beyond blind devotion. Utilizing humanities terror and "despairing frequencies" in allowing both Leviathan and the Paradise a rebirthing process. Within the realm itself, despite its radiance, Chimera reveals that through Leviathan's abilities, they've simply merged Paradise and Hell together where countless lost souls who've become corrupted by the Dark Tide wander, and, due to the Paradise being incomplete, spatial anomalies may occur, such as time flowing differently from the outside world. Though having Napoli's II lantern with its light or Galbrena's using Chimera can reveal the proper path between the two "worlds" in the Paradise. Leviathan's powers has also caused certain myths such as the Styx Lake to become a reality in the realm itself, being as real as the the stories foretell it - but remade by Leviathan as a furnace for lost souls (frequencies) now known as Manes Deep to melt down and remake the caught souls into crude obedient Remnant Creatures. Though those who resist greatly, such as Galbrena's home town, are cast into the deepest reaches of the Dark Tide, condemning to torment without end. Destroying the Journeying Paradise is a way to defeat Leviathan, though only those corrupted by the Dark Tide can enter it properly unless another method is, such as the Waystones, is found. Even then one must be careful when entering the realm as, even with precaution, the Journeying Paradise will slowly corrupt the intruder until they mentally become enslaved. ===Harbinger=== {{Main|Harbinger}} A [[Harbinger]] is a title granted to certain humans selected by the Threnodian Leviathan to spread its doctrine, and sow sorrow and despair among the masses. Influence appears to be a key factor in their selection. Marked by the Dark Tide's corruption, they wield fragments of Leviathan's power, such as the ability to summon its creations and command them. The Harbinger of the Dark Tide are the Anchor of Reality of all Tidespawn, where the Harbinger resonates with Rinasicta's darkest emotions. Those emotions act as Anchors, pulling horror into form and speeding the Tidespawn into existence, especially if the emotions are strong enough which allows Tidespawn to form and evolve further using the Harbinger's thoughts and memories This could allow the Dark Tide to create Tacet Discords from other regions than the local one. In general, the Harbinger will have signs of corruption on them, though the signs aren't always so visible, meaning one must find the associated side effects. Such side-effects include visible markings, memory loss, and an inability to distinguish reality due to falling into corruption and will harm even loved ones as they become Leviathan's puppet with some unaware they may even be the Harbinger itself. Not even the Sentinel’s power can reverse those touched by the Dark Tide unless Leviathan is fully defeated. Some of the Harbingers known are: * Caligula (speculated): A tyrant in Septimont who wielded a dark Resonance Ability that could cause and command the abominations of the Dark Tide itself, which Rover notes as something a Harbinger could do. * [[Napoli II]] (speculated): While never confirmed, he committed various misdeeds due to being corrupted by Leviathan and unable to control himself until his death. * [[Mya]] (speculated): While never confirmed, she was seen alongside Fenrico and passing through the gate and had originally been intended to bring Septimont to ruin. * [[Cartethyia]] (speculated): While never confirmed, she was meant to be Leviathan's Resonator and had brought forth the second Dark Tide up until she went against Leviathan. * [[Fenrico]] (confirmed): Fenrico had been chosen by Leviathan and heavily influenced him to be unaware of this fact. * [[Augusta]] (candidate): Murals and confirmation by Cristoforo reveals Augusta should have been the next Harbinger chosen by the False Sovereign itself before her fate had been changed. * [[Avidius]] (invalid): Only a living person can be a Harbinger, which Avidius wasn't. * [[Rover]] (confirmed): Through Leviathan's actions, it used Rover's link with [[Abby]] and their reputation to make them their Harbinger. ===Brightcloud=== An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds."[[Glossary]], Brightcloud :An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds." The Brightcloud is usually noticed during the event a High Tide occurs. This is a sign that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction.[[Glossary]], High Tide :One of the signs that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction. If unleashed, signs of the Tidal Blight are noticed which is described as scars of the Dark Tide's touch. It may appear as discoloration, calcification, or even coral-like growths, depending on what has been corrupted.[[Glossary]], Tidal Blight :Scars of the Dark Tide's touch. It may appear as discoloration, calcification, or even coral-like growths, depending on what has been corrupted. At its worst, the Dark Tide that falls will spawns Tacet Discords where the epicenter of the event will form a new Tacet Field forms.[[Glossary]], Dark Tide :A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Rinascita, the Dark Tide is a manifestation of the Threnodian Leviathan's power of Unity. Dark clouds amass overhead and crash down like a waterfall, surging in all directions. Wherever the Dark Tide spreads, it spawns Tacet Discords and scars the land with Tidal Blight. At its epicenter, a new Tacet Field forms. However, thanks to the Earthrend Wedge given by Sentinel Imperator, the energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus,[[Glossary]], Earthrend Wedge :A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus. and while the Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area into becoming a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked, the Earthrend Wedge ensures it cannot go any further than the marked location itself.[[Glossary]], Hunt :An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus. :The Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked. :As the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture. Combined with the Anchor Stone, a type of small device manufactured with [[Tacetite]] formed around the Earthrend Wedge, it provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.[[Glossary]], Anchor Stone :A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations. :During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment. This allows the Septimontians during the Hunt to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus. Though were Leviathan be capable of controlling the Dark Tide fully, it will use its control to circumvent the protections in place to overwhelm the Earthrend Wedge for a time for the possibility of destroying the device and allow it to spread the Dark Tide further. ===Dark Tide Creations=== Alongside normal Tacet Discords, Dark Tide Creations are a type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide. They can use the Dark Tide to hide within it unless someone, such as [[Iuno]], is capable of removing their protection, allowing attacks to properly land and deal damage against them. Each one shares slivers of thought and memory with one another. ===Tidespawn=== These are Tacet Discords who have evolved to a much greater level than ordinary Tacet Discords that are form from two methods. The first is thanks to the evolved Dark Tide which has fed on enough human despair, warping that frequency to form Tidespawn, or the second, a Harbinger which feeds them thought and memory and makes them more real. These variants born in such a state are gifted higher intelligence, which allows some of them the ability to speak to others if they please. A few such as the Kelpie Galbrena battled utilized abilities normal variants of its kind should not have due to its heightened evolution. Tidespawn are also capable of disguising themselves as normal humans where they could blend in with other group of humans and potentially kill them unless someone discovers their disguise. They can also create a Paradimensional Tacet Field to set up ambushes and spawn more of their kind through special cocoons inside them. The Tidespawn can corrupt others like the Dark Tide and cause them to see hallucinations if enough of them gather around a person and infect them given enough time, such as Avidius who found himself outnumbered. Within the Journeying Paradise, in the Dark Plane, they also take less damage due to the realm's influence on them. Though the Tidespawn can be weakened and driven back by the Light of Genesis, which may also reveal their true forms and take down their disguises; Order Terminals may also ensure Tidespawn from forming within the area. Tidespawn that also form in enough numbers can be taken down by defeating the "heart", such as the Alpha Tidespawn, or destroying a cocoon, making them weaker and lose form until the next wave arrives. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Dark Tide |zhs = 黑潮 |zht = 黑潮 |ja = 黒潮 |ko = 흑조(黑潮) |es = Marea Oscura |fr = Marée noire |de = Dunkle Flut |th = |pt = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{Lore Navbox|Terminology}} [[zh:黑潮]]
